name: io.github.PabloAlaniz/gsuite-sdk
title: Google Workspace (gsuite-sdk)
description: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Tasks and Contacts for agents, with your own Google login

environmentVariables.name: GSUITE_TOKEN_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the tokens.db written by `gsuite auth login`

environmentVariables.name: GSUITE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Google OAuth client JSON (needed to refresh the login)

environmentVariables.name: GSUITE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for dates without an offset, e.g. America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires
